Inspect Wheel event transitions

Advance one supported Wheel trigger from explicit pre-event state and inspect every changed counter or combat property.

This lab currently covers Doomsday Rampage after card use, Light of Intellect after a Keeper skill, and Eternal Weave plus Rota Fortunae after a pursuit. It does not infer a loadout, create the triggering card, calculate damage, or fill unknown state.
